scope: Source review plus separately authorized exact-source native Linux related gates for the independent F-based prototype. No combination with name-buffer, idle batching, singleton or stage changes.
review: The fast helper requires an existing single-entry hint with unchanged name identity, cache owner, root pointer and revision, then verifies generation, matching A/AAAA kind, positive data length4/16, non-stale state and actual policy validity.
Every rejected helper path is read-only. It does not expire, remove, promote or rotate entries; the original general lookup performs those effects on fallback.

Only a selected valid single address performs the same unlink/link_head promotion as the original hinted single-slot lookup. Multi-record/RRset, CNAME, negative, stale, expired, wrong-kind/length and invalid-hint paths retain the original general owner.
The fast wrapper requires IN, ordinary query header, RD, no DO and no type filtering. Existing outer local/interface/EDNS processing remains before/after this wrapper as originally defined.

The direct reply uses the original PacketWriter flags/question, owner offset12, classIN, Entry.reply_ttl and record_cached ordering. Full follows the same finish_cached_answer TC path, which clears partial response sections.
Entry.is_stale remains strict now>expires; is_valid separately applies the existing retention/expiry policy. No new TTL or equality-boundary rule was introduced.
The general body is byte-identical and only moves behind inline(never). This source refactoring alone does not establish a timing benefit.

test_evidence.matrix_scope: A/AAAA, three times, three RD/CD flag settings, DO/type-filter gates, eight writer limits; compares reply/error outcomes and logging.
test_evidence.hint_fixture: Wrong kind/name identity, successful promotion, expiry rejection without removal, subsequent ordinary expiry removal, old revision and multi-record fallback.

initial_compile_failure.reason: E0369: QueryEvent has no PartialEq; direct Vec<QueryEvent> equality in the new fixture failed to compile.
initial_compile_failure.fix: Compare the complete Debug event snapshots in the fixture; no production equality trait added.

initial_fixture_failure.reason: The fixture expected a many-entry hint after separate same-name/same-kind insert transactions, but insertion correctly replaced the old committed entry.
initial_fixture_failure.fix: Construct both A records in the same insertion batch; retain old-hint invalidation and normal fallback assertions.

limitations: The earlier failures were retained fixture/compiler failures before the final commit; the product helper/general-state semantics were not relaxed to satisfy them.
Related Linux gates omit four complete oracle drivers and do not replace full compatibility/44-family qualification.
No performance gain, exact function cost, candidate acceptance or deployment is established by source review and functional tests.
